answer: Sybils stay cheap if a keypair is enough. Instead, a candidate locks four epochs of expected mining reward, withdrawable only after that clock ends, and receives full grade and vote weight only after five established miners attest. Each attester must come from a distinct invite tree and a non-overlapping nonce window, so the signals cannot simply echo. Those claims form a reef: every signed note, the length of a sonnet, names one observed on-chain act. If a later audit shows coordinated aliases, the leftover bond and a slice of each attester's stake are burned.
